Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner correctly identified that the skull (part of the skeletal system) protects the brain, but erroneously concluded that the answer to the multiple-choice question was "B) the nervous system". In biological classification, the skull is bone, which belongs to the skeletal system (Option C), not the nervous system (Option B), which includes the brain and nerves themselves. The nervous system does not protect the brain; it is the organ being protected. Therefore, the Planner made a factual error in mapping the correct anatomical structure to the wrong option letter.
